about_the_game:
The Planet of Vesta has been invaded by an overwhelming force of robots seeking to extract a material known as Aurichalcum. They will stop at nothing until Vesta is bled dry.

You are Serafina, a fiery sword mage who harnesses the energy of Aurichalcum to cast powerful Arcana in an attempt to cull the herd of invading Syllek.



Aid the Resistance force of Vesta by completing combat missions through which you will grow in strength. At the same time grow your collection of Arcana to use against your robotic foes.

Build your ideal tool set as the Syllek mount a defence to try and stop your advance.

Whatever your choice of action may be, a powerful foe awaits you for a final challenge...

Features:

  •  Dynamic Spell Casting System with 9 unique Spells.

  •  Fast flowing combat where your inputs have to be strategically executed.

  •  Flexible deck building/build crafting system with a large pool of rewards.

  •  5 Unique and Repeatable Mission Types to augment your strength.

  •  A Final Challenging boss fight to test your mettle.

short_description: Ichor Burns is a high-octane action game set in the desolate world of Vesta. Master a dynamic combat system, seamlessly switching between sword and spell. Explore the expansive quarry, challenge the invading darkness, and unlock powerful abilities.

English*, French, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
